about_the_game:
A Rich and Intriguing World

In a land once blessed by the rain of celestial gods, the Bohmaj, former dwellers of the skies, were forced to live among the Selcans, the people of the earth.
Millennia after a cataclysm erased the boundary between heaven and soil, faith turned to fear, and reverence to war.

Now, the continent endures a fragile peace, held together by powerful noble families.
But when Samon Lenastie, Lord of Eracline, is found dead in his sleep, a new storm begins to rise.

Rejecting the throne, his younger son Conor sets out to find his long-lost brother and return the crown to its rightful heir.
What begins as a personal quest soon ignites an ancient conflict between kingdoms…

Deep Tactical Battles

Eternal Legend is a turn-based tactical RPG inspired by the great classics of the genre.
Strategic combat and party management blend into a dark, political epic, where every choice and every battle shapes the fate of your heroes.

Customization and Bonds

Victory is not won on the battlefield alone.
In Eternal Legend, carefully prepare your heroes before each encounter: upgrade their abilities, equip them strategically, choose from dozens of unique classes, and build meaningful bonds between your characters.

Each relationship influences your army’s morale and can turn the tide of a fight.
Strategy, both on and off the battlefield, will forge your legend.

Handcrafted Pixel Art and Animation

Eternal Legend features meticulously crafted pixel art, brought to life with hundreds of hand-drawn animations that capture every strike, spell, and emotion with precision and heart.

Face Titans of Unimaginable Power

Some battles pit you against colossal foes, towering in strength and scale.
These monumental encounters will test both your courage and your strategy — only careful planning and clever tactics will lead you to victory.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible DirectX

short_description: Eternal Legend is a turn-based tactical RPG that blends political drama and family destiny. Build your army, forge bonds, and wage epic pixel art battles in a world torn apart.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, German, Korean
*languages with full audio support
